ordered_effect_composition: Target call order is clip_Push(); clip_SetWin(0x1900); compute and write four local Pt{x,y} records in the 16-byte SS stack array; call f_1FAA_0006(far &pts[0],-1,-1); clip_Pop(). clip_SetWin internally cleans any pending popped clip handle then selects the masked 0x1900 window list.

The clip operations have the same exact implementation/allocator composition as in DrawMapCursor. Push copies current active sentinel-terminated list and prior pointer into a stack node; SetWin copies selected window list into fd_50F6_3C14; Pop restores prior list/pointer and retains popped allocation for subsequent f_1E57_0009 cleanup. All clip handles are allocated/locked/unlocked/freed through the exact pinned f_171C claim chain.

f_1FAA_0006 receives the actual far SS pointer built by the caller, reads p[0].y,p[2].y,p[0].x,p[1].x,p[3].x,p[2].x, computes signed word scanline bounds and 16.16 slopes, and initializes edge accumulators. Caller’s fore/back are both -1. If g_5A97 bit 0 is set, fore is assigned back, which is still -1; thus the raster branch fore==-1 is true on every iteration.

The helper invokes g_9128(-1,-1,-1) once before the loop, then for each signed top<bottom scanline invokes g_913C(x0,top,x1,top+1), updates both fixed-point edges, and repeats. With these flags, g_9134 and g_9138 branches are unreachable. The callback sequence and pointer/argument data are exact; physical pixel writes depend on dynamic callback targets.

g_5746: selected per-window clip handle; cleanup clears it, then clip_SetWin assigns the selected list handle.

g_5AAC: active near-held far Rect pointer; cleanup clears it; SetWin selects copied window list or null; Pop restores prior presence and, if nonnull, saved list contents through shared buffer fd_50F6_3C14.
fd_50F6_3B5C: clip stack head; Push links its new node and Pop restores node[0].
g_5756: clip stack depth; Push increments and Pop decrements.

clip_state_effects.ordered_clip_node_layout: Allocated size is list byte size+8. node[0] stores previous fd_50F6_3B5C; node[1] stores prior g_5AAC pointer/null marker; node+2 stores the copied sentinel-terminated Rect list. Pop tests node[1] for nullness and restores copied bytes from node+2; old pointer identity is not reinstated.
clip_state_effects.normal_preconditions: Window/clip state is caller-valid, active list pointers reference accessible far memory ending in top==0x8000, clip depth is valid (<=20 before push and >0 before pop), and clip node allocations/locks succeed under the separately registered valid-live-heap domain.
clip_state_effects.error_paths: clip_Push calls Punt on null allocation and after depth exceeds 20; clip_SetWin calls Punt if a window reports open but its clip handle is null; clip_Pop calls Punt at depth zero. The C sequence continues after Punt if it returns; the registered helper contracts exclude terminal Punt/invalid-state paths, so no noreturn assumption is made.
